label: Microscope Digital Imaging Suite
description: A high-speed CMOS camera and 4K monitor setup for real-time fossil preparation display and documentation.

components.function: Captures the optical feed from the trinocular port.
Displays the 'Live Feed' of the preparation to the player.
Allows the player to take a 'Snap-Shot' of a discovery without moving their hands from the tools.

game_mechanics.digital_zoom: Player can digitally zoom in on the screen to see matrix grains, though it may become 'pixelated' compared to optical zoom.
game_mechanics.photo_collection: Captured images are saved to the 'Digital Prep Log' we discussed earlier.
